definitions.gloss: to throw out; to toss out
definitions.explanation: To physically throw or toss something out carelessly.

definitions.gloss: to abandon; to give up on; to quit halfway
definitions.explanation: To abandon a task, responsibility, or commitment partway through. Often implies irresponsibility or frustration.

examples.japanese: ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{玄関|げんかん}→玄関：05003_genkan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{放|ほう}り{出|だ}して⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: He tossed his bags at the entrance and ran off.

examples.japanese: {重|おも}すぎて、⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}り{出|だ}してしまった。
examples.english: It was so heavy that I involuntarily tossed the luggage down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}り{出|だ}すわけ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいかない。
examples.english: I can't just abandon my work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}り{出|だ}した。
examples.english: I gave up studying halfway through.

examples.japanese: ⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{立場|たちば}→立場：03403_tachiba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、すべて⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}り{出|だ}して{辞|や}めてしまった。
examples.english: Despite being in a position of responsibility, he abandoned everything and quit.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Godan verb (す ending, conjugates as s-row: {放|ほう}り{出|だ}さない, {放|ほう}り{出|だ}します). Transitive — takes a direct object marked with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧.

USAGE:
Sense 1 (physical throwing) often implies carelessness. Sense 2 (abandoning) is more common in daily conversation and implies giving up irresponsibly. The figurative sense frequently collocates with ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧ (work) or ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧ (study).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}り{出|だ}す (to abandon one's work)
- ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}り{出|だ}す (to give up studying)
- ⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{放|ほう}り{出|だ}す (to quit midway)
- ⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{放|ほう}り{出|だ}す (to toss luggage aside)
